scenes.headline: How a big expert model listens to an hour
scenes.sub: Audio tokens, a frozen diarizer and a hybrid backbone
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lilt! This one model transcribes, translates and tags speakers. Here is how it hears an hour without drowning in memory.

scenes.text: Audio becomes 12.5 tokens a second, speakers are tagged on the way in, and a backbone with few attention layers keeps an hour cheap.
scenes.say: Audio becomes twelve and a half tokens a second, speakers are tagged on the way in, and few attention layers keep a long recording cheap.

scenes.title: From sound to a tagged transcript

steps.say: Log-mel features of each thirty second chunk go into a thirty two layer encoder.
A frozen diarizer estimates who speaks when, and adds a speaker signal to the encoder output.
The result is spliced into the prompt of a fifty two layer language model as audio tokens.
The model writes the transcript, and a small CTC adapter then aligns it to the audio for word times.
Twenty three Mamba layers keep one fixed state, however long the audio runs.
Twenty three expert layers each hold one hundred twenty eight experts, and a token reads six.
Only six layers are attention, so the cache grows slowly: about six thousand bytes a token.

scenes.label: cache for an hour of audio
scenes.say: An hour of audio needs about three hundred forty three megabytes of cache. All attention would need eight point seven times that.

scenes.title: Work for one second of audio
scenes.say: By my count that is a hundred ten billion operations a second, against eighty for Whisper, because the encoder emits a quarter as many frames.

scenes.label: of experts read at 64 requests
scenes.say: Batching helps until nearly every expert is read. At sixty four requests that is ninety five percent, if routing were even.

scenes.text: Listening is cheap here because audio is few tokens and almost no layer keeps a cache.
scenes.say: So listening is cheap because audio is few tokens and almost no layer keeps a cache.
Audio as a few tokens, six experts of a hundred twenty eight, and six attention layers of fifty two.
